name: Nehemiah
title: The Rebuilder of the Wall
summary: Nehemiah was cupbearer to the Persian king Artaxerxes and was appointed governor of Judah. He led the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls in 52 days, despite opposition from enemies. He also carried out social and religious reforms to restore the people.

keyEvents.title: News about Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Nehemiah heard that Jerusalem's walls were in ruins and its gates had been burned. He mourned, fasted, and prayed.

keyEvents.title: Prayer for Help
keyEvents.description: Nehemiah offered a heartfelt prayer asking for forgiveness for the people and that God would grant him favor with the king.

keyEvents.title: The King's Permission
keyEvents.description: King Artaxerxes noticed Nehemiah's sorrow and gave him permission and resources to rebuild Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Building Despite Opposition
keyEvents.description: The people built the wall while carrying weapons because of threats from their enemies. The wall was completed in 52 days.

keyEvents.title: Reforms
keyEvents.description: Nehemiah carried out reforms: he stopped usury, reinstated the tithe, and cleansed the temple of foreigners.
